pricing.intro: Explore the options below. Our team will help you confirm pricing, available content, and the right plan for your setup.
pricing.notice: Prices, connection limits, and content availability are confirmed before purchase. Ask about any trial offer when you enquire.
pricing.steps_subtitle: A little help finding the right fit, at every step.
pricing.step1_text: Start with a plan that suits the number of screens you want to use.
pricing.step2_text: Ask us about the price, your device, content availability, and the terms before you pay.
pricing.step3_text: Our team can explain the appropriate app and activation steps for your device.

channels.intro: Live television, film nights, match days, and something for the family. Browse our content categories and ask about the current lineup.
channels.notice: Browse categories here, then contact us to confirm the channels and titles available with your plan and in your country.
channels.countries_subtitle: Looking for content from home or somewhere new? Our team can help you check the options for your location.

devices.eyebrow: BIG SCREENS. SMALL SCREENS. YOUR SCREENS.
devices.intro: Tell us your device model and where you’ll be watching. We’ll help you check compatibility and the appropriate player before you subscribe.
devices.notice: Compatibility varies by device model, operating system, player, and location. Confirm these details with support before purchasing a plan or installing a paid app.
devices.setup_subtitle: Your exact instructions will depend on the device and player confirmed by our team.
devices.step1_text: Send the device name, model, operating system, and country so we can check the right setup.
devices.step2_text: Follow the installation instructions supplied for your confirmed device. Ask about any separate app costs.
devices.step3_text: Enter the details provided privately by support. Keep your account credentials secure.

reseller.intro: Interested in becoming an Infinity Stream TV reseller? Tell us about your business and market, and we’ll discuss the program with you.
reseller.panel_text: We’ll help you understand the available reseller options, eligibility requirements, and the responsibilities involved.
reseller.feature1: Discuss your market and customer needs
reseller.feature2: Confirm pricing, access, and account limits
reseller.notice: Program access and terms are confirmed individually. Submitting an enquiry does not automatically create a reseller account.
reseller.form_text_static: Add a few details to prepare a WhatsApp message for our team.
reseller.form_text_live: Leave a few details and your preferred contact method.

faq.eyebrow: A LITTLE CLARITY GOES A LONG WAY

contact.intro: Ask about a plan, check a device, or get help with your setup. Share what you need and we’ll take it from there.
contact.panel_text: WhatsApp is our main contact channel. Your message opens for you to review and send.
contact.details_text: For setup help, include your device model and player. For plan enquiries, tell us your country and how many screens you’d like to use.
contact.form_text_static: Fill in the details below to create a WhatsApp draft you can review and send.
contact.form_text_live: Prefer to leave your details? Use the form below.

intro.privacy: How information shared through this website is used, and how to contact us about it.
intro.terms: What to know when using this website and enquiring about an Infinity Stream TV subscription.
intro.refund_policy: How to check the applicable terms and contact us about a cancellation or refund request.

static.body1: The contact and reseller forms prepare a WhatsApp draft using the details you enter, such as your name, country, contact details, selected plan, and message. The form does not send or store an enquiry on this website. You decide whether to send the prepared message in WhatsApp.
static.body2: If you send the WhatsApp message, our team uses the information you share to respond to your enquiry, discuss subscription or reseller options, and provide related setup or support. Provide only the details needed to help with your request.
static.body3: This version of the website prepares form messages in your browser and does not create an enquiry database or a form-security session cookie. The enquiry form does not ask for payment-card details.

live.body1: When you submit a contact or reseller enquiry, we receive the information entered in the form. This may include your name, country, preferred contact method, contact details, selected plan, and message. Provide only the details needed to help with your request.
live.body2: Information submitted through this website is used to respond to your enquiry, discuss subscription or reseller options, and provide related setup or support. Validated enquiries are saved in our enquiry database so they can be handled by the team.
live.body3: This website uses an essential session cookie and form-security tokens to protect enquiry submissions. We do not ask for payment-card details through the enquiry forms.

privacy.body_whatsapp: WhatsApp links open a separate service. You review and send the message yourself. Information shared with WhatsApp is also subject to that service’s privacy practices. Other external links, if used, are governed by their respective providers.
privacy.body_requests: Contact us if you want to ask about an enquiry you submitted, correct its details, or request its deletion. Include enough information to identify your request, but do not send passwords, account credentials, or payment-card information.

terms.body1: This website provides information about Infinity Stream TV, plan options, content categories, device setup, and ways to contact the team. An enquiry is a request for information; it does not itself create a subscription, process a payment, or issue account credentials.
terms.body2: Before purchasing, confirm the current price, billing period, available content, supported devices, number of simultaneous connections, activation process, and applicable cancellation or refund terms directly with support.
terms.body3: Content and device options can vary by plan, location, device model, operating system, and player. Category images illustrate the type of content being discussed. Ask for confirmation of any specific channel, title, app, or device that matters to you.
terms.body4: Trial availability, duration, and eligibility must be confirmed with support. Reseller enquiries are assessed separately, and any account access or commercial terms are provided only after the relevant arrangement is confirmed.
terms.body5: Keep any account details provided to you private. Follow the usage limits and setup instructions confirmed for your plan. Do not send account passwords or other sensitive credentials through the public enquiry form.
terms.body6: If a detail is unclear, ask for written confirmation before paying. The subscription information confirmed during your enquiry should explain the service and terms you are agreeing to.

refund.heading1: Check the terms before you pay
refund.body1: The website does not process subscription payments. Contact support before purchasing to confirm whether a refund or cancellation is available for your selected plan, along with any eligibility conditions, deadlines, and payment arrangements.
refund.body2: Contact the team on WhatsApp with your plan name, purchase or activation date, and a brief explanation of your request. Include an order or transaction reference if you have one. Do not send full payment-card details, passwords, or private account credentials.
refund.heading3: If you are having a setup issue
refund.body3: Share your device model, player, and a description of the problem so support can review the setup. You may also request clarification of the cancellation or refund terms that were confirmed when you purchased.
refund.body4: The team will review your request against the terms agreed for your subscription and explain the available next steps. Submitting a request through this website or WhatsApp does not automatically confirm a refund or cancellation.
